audit.why: Even lane, Taliyah-favored early via range, Swain-favored in extended fights post-6; content layer already reflects this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carried blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet both say Taliyah 1-4/first item, Swain at 6 and 2+ items.
audit.why: The two layers must agree; content and packet agree with each other, so full sides are moved to match, whys rewritten to support each verdict.
audit.corrected: phases[0-6].side set to Taliyah/Taliyah/Taliyah/Taliyah/Swain/Taliyah/Swain with matching whys and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; anti-heal against Ravenous Flock was flagged missing; Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad strings.
audit.why: Swain R is 120s, E (Nevermove) 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Taliyah W 14s at rank 1 — real numbers make the windows concrete. His passive heals and stacks max HP, so Grievous Wounds (Ignite early, Oblivion Orb) matters and resist-stacking alone does not answer him.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with digits; Ignite framed as early anti-heal; Oblivion Orb added to the item spike text; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Swain wins by landing Demonic Ascension, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Swain wins by rooting you with Nevermove, pulling you into Demonic Ascension, and healing off every second you stay.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Q on fresh ground outranges everything Swain has at 1 — poke him off every soul-fragment last-hit before he can answer back.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove Swain back whenever he steps up to collect souls — he has no dash to punish it.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: W him across your E mines for the stun — his 12s E (Nevermove) is his only answer and it's dodgeable.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave and zone him off farm; his ult isn't up yet so fights still favor you.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Swain

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension flips extended fights — his drain plus soul heals outlast your burst. Roam with Weaver's Wall instead.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's spike: your poke zones him again — land Q and reset before his 120s R can drain it back. Short trades only.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Swain

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late, his R uptime and stacked healing make him unkillable one-on-one — wall his engage, peel with E, never take the brawl.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Seismic Shove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension (120s): his drain mode — disengage when it starts and commit only in its downtime. - Nevermove sits at 12s early — after he misses it you have a free trade window. - Your W (14s) is the combo-starter; never spend it on poke.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Crash the wave, then surf Weaver's Wall to bot or river — Swain has no dash and can't match your roam speed, so his answer arrives late.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Your W is your only displacement and your escape from his E pull — spent on chip damage, you have nothing for 14 seconds.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP feeds the roam plan and wins the reset war; Ignite is the early anti-heal his soul-stacking passive begs for.

edits.before: With Riftmaker/Rylai's Swain becomes a sustain tank you can't kill in a straight fight, but your ranged Q still zones him off farm and you win short trades.
edits.after: With Riftmaker/Rylai's Swain becomes a sustain tank — buy Oblivion Orb by then or his passive healing eats your poke; your ranged Q still zones him off farm.
